name: SSI2190
description: Six-into-one voltage controlled mixer built from six independent new-generation OTAs, each with differential voltage inputs and a current-mode linear control input, summed to a single high-compliance current output. The high-compliance MIX OUT allows multiple SSI2190s to be paralleled for more than six inputs. Differential inputs support phase correction and differential signal paths. Wide split/single supply range targets everything from effects pedals to prosumer mixing gear; datasheet used for this entry is marked PRELIMINARY (Rev 1.4, July 2024) with several spec-table values still unpublished (shown as 'xx' placeholders in the vendor sheet).

extra.datasheet status: vendor PDF is marked PRELIMINARY (Rev 1.4, July 2024); several spec-table entries (ISY max, gm min/max, gm tracking, control feedthrough, max attenuation, input resistance, output offset current, max output current, headroom, channel separation, slew rate) are unpublished placeholders ('xx') in the source sheet, not omissions by this entry

typical_application: Six-channel voltage-controlled audio/CV mixer for synth voice architectures and mixing consoles: sum up to six differential inputs to one current output, with per-channel linear (current-mode) level control referenced to CTRL REF. MIX OUT pins of multiple SSI2190s can be paralleled to extend beyond six inputs. Typical application circuit (datasheet Figure 1) uses a TL072-based current-to-voltage output stage (26.1k ROUT, 150pF CF) and a 49.9k/221R input attenuator network per channel.
gotchas: differential input (IN+ to IN-) must stay within +-100mV typ (+-1V typ max per spec table, +-4V absolute max); this is a small-signal differential port, not a general-purpose differential line receiver
CTRL REF (pin 13) must be tied to control ground (bipolar supply) or a pseudo-ground (single supply); floating it breaks all six control inputs since they're referenced to it
pins 11 and 14 are NC and must be left unconnected per the datasheet
MIX OUT is a high-compliance current output, not a voltage output; needs an external transimpedance stage (see Figure 1's TL072 + ROUT/CF) to get a usable voltage signal

datasheet used is a PRELIMINARY revision (1.4, July 2024) with numerous spec values still unpublished ('xx' in the vendor's own table); treat gm min/max, ISY max, control feedthrough, output offset current, max output current, headroom, channel separation, and slew rate as unconfirmed until Sound Semiconductor issues a final sheet
sold only directly by Sound Semiconductor and its authorized resellers, not a general second-sourced part
